strengths: The repository separates Kakao chatbot, Channel Talk, and Naver TalkTalk surfaces.
Read-only defaults and fixture-first examples are visible.
failures: Provider and channel mismatches were not rejected deterministically.
REQUEST_ACCEPTED could be represented as delivered.
Unauthenticated Channel Talk production input and high-risk Korean identifiers were not sufficiently gated.
Conflicting replays could be silently deduplicated.
